title: 刚刚，Claude水印一夜变废纸
content: A GitHub project called watermarks-remover has gained 11,000 stars for stripping AI watermarks from major models. The open-source tool removes Anthropic's statistical text watermarking in Claude, Google's SynthID-Text, and OpenAI's hidden markers through a three-layer approach: cleaning invisible Unicode characters, using agent-based rewriting with alternative models to destroy statistical patterns, and stripping C2PA/EXIF metadata from images and PDFs. title: 弄懂这 5 个AI术语，你就超过了90%的人

"Temperature" controls output randomness: low for factual tasks, high for creative ones. "Hallucination" occurs when AI confidently generates false information because it predicts plausible text rather than retrieving facts. "RAG" (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) lets AI answer questions using uploaded documents by retrieving relevant snippets first. Understanding these five concepts enables more effective, critical AI use.

Six viable stock market strategies for ordinary investors: (1) Buy broad-based index ETFs during major crashes for 30-40% gains. (2) Focus on one or two quality stocks, trading bands to reduce cost basis. (3) Accumulate dividend stocks yielding ~5%, especially state-owned enterprises bought at lows.
